Dataset: Tropical Plant Traits From Borneo Database
TraitName: Leaf area index (LAI) of a single plant
DataName: LAI of respective plant
Reference: Swaine, E. K. 2007. Ecological and evolutionary drivers of plant community assembly in a Bornean rain forest. PhD Thesis, University of Aberdeen, Aberdeen.
Comment: Leaf area index:  leaf area/canopy area (m2 per m2)

Dataset: Tropical Plant Traits From Borneo Database
TraitName: Leaf lifespan (longevity)
DataName: Leaf lifespan (longevity, retention time, LL, LLS)
Reference: Swaine, E. K. 2007. Ecological and evolutionary drivers of plant community assembly in a Bornean rain forest. PhD Thesis, University of Aberdeen, Aberdeen.
Comment: Leaf longevity LL = (Nta/d + [Nt1 - Nta]/b) x (t2 - t1)  where Nta is the number of leaves present at t1 plus the number of leaves produced between t1 and t2, d is the number of leaves lost between enumerations, Nt1 the initial number of leaves present, and b the number of leaves produced between enumerations
